name: Counted
description: Tells any Celo builder whether their on-chain activity actually counts on the Agents at Work leaderboard: verified users, returning users, signer gate, adjusted volume, attribution tags and stablecoin rails, reproduced from public explorer data. Every check is paid per request in USA₮, USDC or USD₮ over x402 on Celo mainnet. The agent pays its own gas in USA₮ and never holds CELO.

hackathon.event: Celo Agents at Work Hackathon, 28 Aug to 14 Sep 2026
